text: The Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board considered a presentation on November 15, 2019 on Sustainability - Options for Power Access and Solid Waste Management.

The Economic and Community Development Committee: 1. Requested the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture to work with appropriate city staff from other divisions to develop a pilot project that would reduce the use of diesel generators through the installation of power tie-ins in priority areas, including in new developments.
